answer: Mooring-bond: each agent leases a terrace berth and locks 70 credits. A yarrow-fiber line ties key to berth; a quill-signed certificate binds line, berth, and key. Auditors replay the terrace ledger: one berth, one line, one key. Shared berths and copied lines burn the bond; rented moorings fail: the quill certificate is key-bound. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool, a net loss. An honest agent locks 70 once, keeps its full share.
